headline: Barry Callebaut Flavourcode; Planet A cocoa replacer; Roquette GF hydrocolloid; US dye-ban bill
summary: Barry Callebaut's Flavourcode puts controlled cocoa fermentation for consistent chocolate flavour on the market, a direct challenge Belcolade should benchmark and answer with its own fermentation-flavour offer.

Planet A Foods is moving from cocoa-free chocolate into a high-fibre cocoa powder replacer pitched at cost and GLP-1 trends, so Belcolade should assess it as a partner or competitor for cocoa-saving solutions.

Roquette's Wellence GF 1229 hydrocolloid and Palsgaard's powdered cake emulsifier target gluten-free bread volume and cake quality, so benchmark them against Puratos gluten-free mixes and cake improvers.

In the US, pressure for a federal ultra-processed food definition continues and a new House bill would ban synthetic dyes, so prepare clean-label and natural-colour options for bakery, patisserie and chocolate customers.
Sourdough research shows back-slopping temperature steers microbiota and bread quality, a practical lever for Sapore sourdough development.

items.title: Barry Callebaut unveils new fermentation-based chocolate flavour solution, Flavourcode
items.summary: Barry Callebaut launched Flavourcode, a fermentation-based approach to creating consistent, distinctive chocolate flavours.
items.why: A direct competitor move in controlled cocoa fermentation, the area Belcolade is working on; assess the gap and accelerate Belcolade's own fermentation-flavour offer.

items.title: Development of Cocoa Butter Equivalent from Tengkawang and Coconut Oils via Chemical Interesterification
items.summary: Indonesian researchers made cocoa butter equivalents by chemically interesterifying blends of tengkawang (illipe) butter and coconut oil to match cocoa butter melting behaviour.
items.why: Illipe-based CBEs are a lever against cocoa butter price swings for Belcolade compounds and coatings; worth tracking as an alternative-fat sourcing option.

items.title: What’s old is new again: Fresh speculation about defining ultra-processed foods
items.summary: Commentary on renewed speculation about a US federal definition of ultra-processed foods.
items.why: A federal UPF definition would hit packaged bread, cakes and confectionery; keep clean-label, fewer-additive reformulation options ready for US customers.

items.title: Rep. Nancy Mace Introduces Bill to Ban Synthetic Dyes from America's Food, Medicine, and Cosmetics
items.summary: US Representative Nancy Mace introduced a bill to ban synthetic dyes from food, medicine and cosmetics.
items.why: A federal synthetic-dye ban would hit coloured glazes, decorations, fillings and coloured chocolate; accelerate natural-colour alternatives for US patisserie and Belcolade customers.

items.title: Can incorporating grape pomace into bread sustainably enhance its antioxidant capacity?
items.summary: Portuguese researchers baked pilot-scale breads with 5-15% red or white grape pomace flour, raising fibre, polyphenols and antioxidant capacity, and tested consumer acceptance.
items.why: Upcycled grape pomace flour is a candidate fibre and antioxidant ingredient for sustainable bread concepts; a possible academic partner for Puratos upcycling work.

items.title: High-Fibre Breadsticks Fortified with Artichoke By-Product Extract and Inulin: Technological Quality, Phenolic Retention, and Consumer Acceptance
items.summary: Breadsticks fortified with an artichoke by-product extract and artichoke inulin doubled dietary fibre to about 8.8 g/100 g while keeping good sensory acceptance.
items.why: Artichoke by-product extract plus inulin is an upcycled route to high-fibre claims in bread and savoury bakery that Puratos could test in fibre-enrichment mixes.

items.title: WinCo recalls hoagie rolls sold in Nevada over undeclared sesame
items.summary: US retailer WinCo recalled hoagie rolls sold in Nevada because they contained undeclared sesame.
items.why: Sesame is now a major US allergen and bread recalls keep recurring; a reminder to tighten sesame cross-contact and labelling guidance for Puratos bakery customers.
